title: kbmon's live view redraws to the terminal's new size as soon as the window is resized
goal: Operator feedback 2026-10-18: "I need it resizing progressively with terminal window". Today the live view reads shutil.get_terminal_size only when a frame is due (every --interval seconds, default 5), so after a resize the old frame wraps or is cut until the next refresh. The live view redraws the last snapshot at the new width and height right after a resize, without re-reading the panels: on POSIX on SIGWINCH, on Windows (no SIGWINCH) by polling the size a few times a second between refreshes; a shrink clears the screen first so no stale text is left; --once, --json and a pipe are unchanged.

run:
import os,pty,sys,time,struct,fcntl,termios,signal,select,json,tempfile,subprocess
snap=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w",suffix=".json",delete=False)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--json","--panel","kb"],stdout=snap,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); snap.close()
def setsz(fd,r,c): fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack("HHHH",r,c,0,0))
pid,fd=pty.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.execvp(sys.executable,[sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--from-snapshot",snap.name,"--interval","30","--count","3"])
setsz(fd,24,60)
buf=b"";t=time.time()
while time.time()-t<4:
    r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.2)
    if r:
        try: buf+=os.read(fd,65536)
        except OSError: break
    if b"kbmon" in buf and time.time()-t>1.5: break
setsz(fd,40,140); os.kill(pid,signal.SIGWINCH)
buf2=b"";t=time.time()
while time.time()-t<2:
    r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.2)
    if r:
        try: buf2+=os.read(fd,65536)
        except OSError: break
os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
import re
lines=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]",b"\n",buf2).split(b"\n")
w=max((len(l.rstrip()) for l in lines),default=0)
print("widest line after resize:",w)
sys.exit(0 if w>60 else 1)

import os,pty,sys,time,struct,fcntl,termios,signal,select,tempfile,subprocess,re
snap=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w",suffix=".json",delete=False)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--json","--panel","kb"],stdout=snap,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); snap.close()
def setsz(fd,r,c): fcntl.ioctl(fd,termios.TIOCSWINSZ,struct.pack("HHHH",r,c,0,0))
def read(fd,secs,stop=None):
    b=b"";t=time.time()
    while time.time()-t<secs:
        r,_,_=select.select([fd],[],[],0.2)
        if r:
            try: b+=os.read(fd,65536)
            except OSError: break
        if stop and stop(b,time.time()-t): break
    return b
pid,fd=pty.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.execvp(sys.executable,[sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--from-snapshot",snap.name,"--interval","30","--count","3"])
setsz(fd,40,140)
read(fd,4,lambda b,e: b"kbmon" in b and e>1.5)
setsz(fd,24,60); os.kill(pid,signal.SIGWINCH)
after=read(fd,2)
os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
if b"\x1b[2J" not in after: print("no clear-screen redraw within 2 s of a shrink"); sys.exit(1)
tail=after[after.rindex(b"\x1b[2J"):]
lines=re.sub(rb"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]",b"\n",tail).split(b"\n")
w=max((len(l.rstrip()) for l in lines),default=0)
print("widest line after the shrink's clear:",w)
sys.exit(0 if 0<w<=60 else 1)
